config.modelsHeader:
# Tomcat model catalog (models.toml)
#
# Add, remove or edit models here without changing code or rebuilding.
# On startup this file is merged with the built-in catalog: matching IDs
# override built-in models, and new IDs add models.
#
# Fields:
#   id              Local model ID for selection and display
#   model_name      Upstream model name; defaults to id
#   api             Wire protocol: openai | openai-responses | anthropic-messages
#   provider        Logical vendor; selects the <PROVIDER>_API_KEY variable
#   api_key_env     Explicit credential variable; otherwise inferred from provider
#   base_url        Host or vendor path; endpoint leaf is added based on api
#                   For example host -> /v1/<leaf>; /api/paas/v4 is preserved
#   thinking_format openai | deepseek | qwen | doubao | anthropic, etc.
#   capabilities    vision/files/tools/reasoning/web_search flags
#   context_window     Context limit shared by input history and actual output
#   max_output_tokens  Per-turn output limit shared by thinking and text
#
# Store API keys in ~/.tomcat/assets/.env (permissions 0600), not in this file.
# To add a model, copy a block below and change id/provider/base_url.

slash.help:
Available commands:
  /path <absolute-path>      Request path access (session / persistent / readonly / deny / cancel)
  /model [current|list|use <id>]  Show the current model, list the catalog, or change model
  /effort <low|medium|high|xhigh>  Set reasoning effort (saved per model)
  /context <tokens>         Choose a supported Context tier (saved per model)
  /command list | /command use <id> [instructions]  List or invoke project commands
  /<command-name> [instructions]  Invoke a uniquely named project command
  /skill list              List discovered skills (including user-only)
  /skill reload            Rescan and replace the current SkillSet
  /skill use <name> "intent..."  Include skill instructions with this turn's intent
  /connector list          Show MCP server sources, connection status and tool counts
  /connector add <name> <command> [args...]  Add to global mcp.json
  /connector trust-project Trust this project's MCP services
  /connector test|tools <name>  Test connection or inspect tools
  /connector remove <name> Remove from global mcp.json
  /connector reload        Reload mcp.json and reconnect
  /ckpt list [--limit N]    List recent checkpoints
  /ckpt show <id>           Show checkpoint metadata
  /ckpt diff <id>           Compare checkpoint with the workspace
  /restore <id> [--path <rel>]... [--dry-run]  Restore all or part of a checkpoint
  /compact                 Compact context and continue with a summary
  /thinking [minimal|summary|full|toggle]  Change thinking display (default=toggle; on/off supported)
  /plan                      Enter PLAN mode (saved under ~/.tomcat/plans/)
  /plan exit               Return to Chat
  /plan build <plan_id/path> Enter EXEC mode
  /plan list               List plans under ~/.tomcat/plans/
  /help                    Show this help
